newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: ALPINE SKIING-REITER TO MISS NIGHT SLALOM.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-REITER TO MISS NIGHT SLALOM.

text.p: Austria's Mario Reiter, winner of last weekend's slalom in Kitzbuehel, has a slight bout of influenza and has opted to give Thursday's World Cup night slalom in Schladming a miss.
Reiter's manager Valentin Hobel said Reiter, 26, preferred to save his energies for the world championships in Sestriere starting on Sunday.
The 1996 world championship slalom silver medalist will take part in the combination and the slalom.
Reiter's victory in Kitzbuehel came as a surprise as he had a poor start to the season due to health problems he did not want to discuss.
The first leg of the men's slalom on Thursday was to begin at 1800 local time (1700 GMT) and the second run at 2045 (1945 GMT).
